final: WITH g AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(CASE WHEN rebtotal <> 0 THEN rebtotal END) AS avg_reb, AVG(CASE WHEN rebrate <> 0 AND feerate <> 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) * 1.0 / feerate END) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal, AVG(g.avg_gap) AS avg_of_avg_gap, AVG(g.avg_reb - b.bench) AS avg_excess FROM g, b WHERE g.avg_reb > b.bench
